pr_title: GameEngine: document validation baseline concurrency recovery
pr_body:
## Summary

Records INC-004 for validation scope pollution when main advances after a task-branch baseline, and updates the Dispatcher producer protocol to re-check current main before ready publication for normal main-based work.

The recovery was proven by ADR 0127 request `adr0127-native-2d-20260816-1208-02` and Windows Validation run `31923640542`.
